ucs.title: [LLM] Mustang Panda PlugX DLL side-loading: vendor-signed binary executing from user-writable path
ucs.description: Detects Mustang Panda's signature PlugX/Korplug delivery chain where the actor drops a legitimately signed third-party binary (Adobe, Avast, ESET, OneDrive, McAfee, HP, Lenovo) into %APPDATA%, %PUBLIC%, %PROGRAMDATA% or %TEMP% so that it side-loads an attacker-controlled DLL plus an encrypted .DAT payload sitting in the same folder. Vendor utilities of this name never legitimately live in those user-writable directories, so the path-plus-name combination is the high-fidelity tell that distinguishes this from generic DLL side-loading.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("AdobeUpdate.exe","Acrobat.exe","AcroBroker.exe","AvastSvc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","EACore.exe","HPCustParticipation.exe","HxTsr.exe","McUICnt.exe","mcvsmap.exe","OneDrive.exe","LenovoEmailIcon.exe","SoundReco.exe","hkcmd.exe","plugins.exe","RTSCom.exe","VLC.exe","ClientVPN.exe") AND Processes.process_path IN ("*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*","*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\PerfLogs\\*","*\\Recycle.bin\\*","*\\Windows\\Temp\\*") AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval firstTime=strftime(firstTime,"%F %T"), lastTime=strftime(lastTime,"%F %T") | join type=left dest [| tstats `summariesonly` count as datDrops values(Filesystem.file_name) as dat_files from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action="created" AND Filesystem.file_name IN ("*.dat","*.DAT","*.bin") AND Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\PerfLogs\\*") by Filesystem.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`]
ucs.kql:
let MustangPandaHosts = dynamic(["adobeupdate.exe","acrobat.exe","acrobroker.exe","avastsvc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","eacore.exe","hpcustparticipation.exe","hxtsr.exe","mcuicnt.exe","mcvsmap.exe","onedrive.exe","lenovoemailicon.exe","soundreco.exe","hkcmd.exe","plugins.exe","rtscom.exe","vlc.exe","clientvpn.exe"]);
let SuspectPaths = dynamic([@"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Recycle.bin\", @"\Windows\Temp\"]);
let SideLoads = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where tolower(FileName) in (MustangPandaHosts)
| where FolderPath has_any (SuspectPaths)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","setup.exe","setupexe.exe","services.exe");
let DatDrops = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| where FileName endswith ".dat" or FileName endswith ".bin"
| where FolderPath has_any (SuspectPaths)
| project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DroppedFile = FileName, DropFolder = FolderPath, Dropper = InitiatingProcessFileName;
SideLoads
| join kind=leftouter DatDrops on DeviceId
| where isempty(DropFolder) or (DropFolder =~ FolderPath and abs(datetime_diff('hour', DropTime, Timestamp)) <= 24)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName, ProcessVersionInfoProductName, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          DroppedFile, DropFolder, DropTime
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let MustangPandaHosts = dynamic(["adobeupdate.exe","acrobat.exe","acrobroker.exe","avastsvc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","eacore.exe","hpcustparticipation.exe","hxtsr.exe","mcuicnt.exe","mcvsmap.exe","onedrive.exe","lenovoemailicon.exe","soundreco.exe","hkcmd.exe","plugins.exe","rtscom.exe","vlc.exe","clientvpn.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ImageName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ImageName in (MustangPandaHosts)
| where NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(AppData\\Roaming|AppData\\Local\\Temp|Users\\Public|ProgramData|PerfLogs|Recycle\.bin|Windows\\Temp)\\"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName !endswith "msiexec.exe" and ParentProcessName !endswith "services.exe"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, ProcessId, TokenElevationType
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Mustang Panda PlugX DLL Side-Loading via Vendor-Signed Binary in User-Writable Path
id: 4b5f7c41-2d6a-4a2b-9c12-3b6cb7c8f0a1
status: experimental
description: Detects Mustang Panda / Earth Preta PlugX delivery where a legitimately signed vendor utility runs from a non-standard user-writable directory to side-load a malicious DLL plus encrypted .DAT payload.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/g/earth-preta-mustang-panda.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026-05-21
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AdobeUpdate.exe'
      - '\Acrobat.exe'
      - '\AcroBroker.exe'
      - '\AvastSvc.exe'
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\EACore.exe'
      - '\HPCustParticipation.exe'
      - '\HxTsr.exe'
      - '\McUICnt.exe'
      - '\mcvsmap.exe'
      - '\OneDrive.exe'
      - '\LenovoEmailIcon.exe'
      - '\SoundReco.exe'
      - '\hkcmd.exe'
      - '\plugins.exe'
      - '\RTSCom.exe'
      - '\ClientVPN.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
      - '\Recycle.bin\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
  filter_installer:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\setup.exe'
      - '\services.exe'
  condition: selection_image and selection_path and not filter_installer
falsepositives:
  - Software development environments staging vendor binaries for testing
  - Portable-app launchers (rare in managed enterprise estates)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\AdobeUpdate.exe OR *\\adobeupdate.exe OR *\\Acrobat.exe OR *\\acrobat.exe OR *\\AvastSvc.exe OR *\\avastsvc.exe OR *\\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\\EACore.exe OR *\\eacore.exe OR *\\HPCustParticipation.exe OR *\\McUICnt.exe OR *\\mcuicnt.exe OR *\\OneDrive.exe OR *\\onedrive.exe OR *\\LenovoEmailIcon.exe OR *\\SoundReco.exe OR *\\soundreco.exe OR *\\hkcmd.exe OR *\\plugins.exe OR *\\RTSCom.exe OR *\\HxTsr.exe) AND @Image:(*\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\users\\public\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\programdata\\* OR *\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\windows\\temp\\*) AND -@ParentImage:(*\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\services.exe OR *\\setup.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(adobeupdate|acrobat|acrobroker|avastsvc|wsc_proxy|eacore|hpcustparticipation|hxtsr|mcuicnt|mcvsmap|onedrive|lenovoemailicon|soundreco|hkcmd|plugins|rtscom|clientvpn)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(AppData\\Roaming|AppData\\Local\\Temp|Users\\Public|ProgramData|PerfLogs|Recycle\.bin|Windows\\Temp)\\/i
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/^(msiexec|services|setup|setupexe)\.exe$/i
| UserName!="SYSTEM"
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] Mustang Panda HIUPAN / PlugX-USB worm execution from removable-drive RECYCLE.BIN folder
ucs.description: Detects Earth Preta / Mustang Panda's USB worm component (HIUPAN, SnakeDisk, U2DiskWatch, PlugX-USB) which hides a victim's real files on a removable drive with attrib +s +h, drops the PlugX payload into a hidden $RECYCLE.BIN or '.delete' subdirectory on that drive, and creates LNK shortcuts with the original filenames so a double-click launches cmd.exe / rundll32.exe targeting the hidden payload on D:–Z:. This LNK-explorer-cmd-USBpath chain is uniquely Mustang Panda — the only Chinese APT documented to industrialize PlugX-USB as the primary lateral-movement vector in Southeast Asia.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="explorer.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe") AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process, "(?i)[D-Z]:\\\\.*\\\\(\$?RECYCLE\.BIN|System Volume Information|\.delete|\$Recycle\.Bin)\\\\") | eval firstTime=strftime(firstTime,"%F %T"), lastTime=strftime(lastTime,"%F %T")
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\"\s]*\\(\$?RECYCLE\.BIN|System Volume Information|\.delete|\$Recycle\.Bin)\\"
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\"\s]*\.(exe|dll|dat|bat|vbs)\b"
   and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)attrib(\.exe)?\s+\+s\s+\+h|/c\s+start\s+[D-Z]:\\"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\explorer.exe"
| extend ImageName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ImageName in ("cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe")
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\"\s]*\\(\$?RECYCLE\.BIN|System Volume Information|\.delete|\$Recycle\.Bin)\\"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, ProcessId
